output.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cancelled_orders
FROM marts.fct_orders
WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND LOWER(status) = 'cancelled';
output.explanation: The query counts the orders in marts.fct_orders that were placed in 2025 (order_date from 2025-01-01 up to, but not including, 2026-01-01) and have the status 'cancelled'. It ignores capitalisation when checking the status. I couldn't check which status values actually appear in the data. If cancellations are stored under another spelling, such as 'canceled', the filter needs to change to match.
